High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Ms. Vinita Dwivedi, Learned Panel Lawyer For The
 Respondent/State.)
ORDER Heard and perused the record.

2. This is the first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.132/2024, registered at Police Station- Rajod, District-Dhar (M.P.), for the offence under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), 344,
506 of the IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 19.06.2024.
3. As per prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.

Though the allegation against the applicant is that he has kidnapped the prosecutrix by threatening to kill her, but as per prosecution case she has resided with the applicant for 20 days, however, she has not raised any alarm or registered complaint against the applicant regarding commission of rape.
FIR is also delayed by 20 days.
Prosecutrix is a major lady.
As per the MLC report, no injury was found on the 2 MCRC-27524-2024 person of the prosecutrix.
The applicant is in jail since 19.06.2024 and conclusion of trial will take a long time.
Under these circumstances, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the prayer and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text: 1 6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that it is a fit case for grant of bail.
Consequently without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
